headlines.title: Constellation Energy Has Faded Since Last December: Why BMO Sees 23% Upside
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBMO Capital raised its Constellation Energy price target to $335 from $316 and kept its Outperform rating, about 23% above the stock’s Nov. 17 close.

headlines.title: Bernstein Cut Its Constellation Energy Target to $293. It Still Sees 5% Upside
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBernstein cut its Constellation Energy price target to $293 from $296 and kept its Outperform rating, leaving about 5% upside. The stock is 27% below its December 2025 high after a soft 2026 outlook, a jump in debt and a midterm scare over data centers.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy vs. Vistra: Which Utilities Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Vistra trades at a lower forward P/E than Constellation Energy, but its heavier debt load and thinner free cash flow raise questions worth weighing.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
